en:
<CLT=cltMIND>So this is the warehouse...
It's enormous, even for a warehouse.
It must be difficult to find anything...
Arghhh, dammit... Why aren't they here?

<CLT=cltMIND>A conspicuous girl is rummaging
through a shelf full of chemicals...

Ah, excuse me?
Are you looking for something?
Don't fuckin' talk to me, asshole!

<CLT=cltMIND>Well that's a rather rude way of
saying hello...

Hey, I'm sorry that I disturbed you,
but you don't have to—
Hey, crotchrot.
...What? Me?
You just stared at my tits, didn't ya?
What?

Can't say I blame ya! A beta like you has no
chance with a big-titted beauty like me!
Go on, get yourself a good eyeful!

N-No! I wasn't staring, I just happened
to look down while—

"Ohh, my eyes just happened to look there..."
"Ohh, my hand just happened to grope her..."

Bullshit! I can identify pervs on sight, and
you are *definitely* a fuckin' perv!

That's why you wear that hat, right?
To hide your skeevy eyes?

And that's why you wear those pants, right?
To hide your nasty crotch?
...Am I not allowed to wear pants, now?

Hah-haha! Everyone knows that only pervs
wear hats!
What are you even talking about?

Just leave me alone!
I can wear whatever I want!
Heeee!

Wh-What the hell...are you gettin' pissed off
at me for?
T-Tell the world you're sorry!

If you shock me into losing motivation, the
loss will be felt throughout the whole world!

Hey, you're spouting a lot of nonsense!
Who are you!?
Seriously!? You dunno who the fuck I am!?

I'm the gorgeous girl genius whose good looks
and golden brain will go down in history!

I'm the one, the only, the legendary
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Inventor<CLT=cltNORMAL> herself—<CLT=cltSTRONG>Miu Iruma<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu Iruma, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Inventor<CLT=cltMIND>...
Never heard of her...

So what kind of inventions
do you make anyway?

I make all kinds of gadgets—ones that let you
type while you sleep, read while you sleep...
Even ones that let you eat while you sleep.
Why does everything involve sleeping?

I was inspired after I realized how much time
people waste on sleep.

Though, this one time I invented these really
stupid eyedrop contact lenses as a gag.

Wait, really? That's your invention?
Some of my friends wear it!

Psh! Your friends sound like total plebs!
That invention was nothing!

It doesn't make you more productive while you
sleep, so it was a failure! Just like you two!

I signed the patent rights over to some
company and never looked back.

<CLT=cltMIND>That seems like a missed opportunity...
That kind of technology sounds incredible.

By the way, what were you looking for earlier?
You sounded pretty desperate to find it.

Eh? Are you a dumbass? In a situation like
this, I gotta find some meds!

Medicine? Are you hurt?
Or feeling sick?

No, idiot! I need strong meds cuz I wanna
trip my fuckin' balls off!

*sigh*... I just wanna set my mind free and
forget all about this shitty situation!
<CLT=cltMIND>What? Is that...?

Wait... Whaaaaaat!? You can't use drugs to
get high! You definitely shouldn't do that!
Heeee!

Wh-What the hell...? My genius can't be
constrained by the wisdom of the masses...

Besides...this place probably doesn't even
have the shit I need to get loosey-goosey...

S-So...are we cool...?
Are you...done being mad at me?

<CLT=cltMIND>The line between genius and insanity is a
thin one, and Miu has passed it by a mile.
<CLT=cltMIND>What's up with Shuichi?

<CLT=cltMIND>He's been quiet ever since Miu mentioned
his hat... Does he not like to talk about it?

Eh!? Leave me alone!
I'm busy!
<CLT=cltMIND>Looks like she's busy right now...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this...a sensor?
It looks like a complicated device.

<CLT=cltMIND>A monitor...
I feel like I've gotten used to seeing these.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a shot put ball.
Do they have track and field events here?

<CLT=cltMIND>An RC helicopter...
I bet some of the guys would like this.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's lots of track and field equipment in here.
This is a crossbar for high jump.
<CLT=cltMIND>These mats are pretty heavy...

<CLT=cltMIND>So they have hurdles too.
We could have a sports festival with all this...

<CLT=cltMIND>A disposable camera? This might be
the first time I've ever seen one in real life...

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this photographic developer?
Looks like there are other chemicals here as well.
